title: "Fish"
engine: markdown
extensions:
  term:
    shell: fish

    init: []
    spacing: false
---

Fish doesn't use `PS1` — it uses a `fish_prompt` function. Use fish's `-C` flag to define a simple prompt before the shell starts:

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: fish
    shell-args: ["--no-config", "-C", "function fish_prompt; echo -n '$ '; end"]
    prompt: "$"
```

## Basic Usage

```{term}
echo "Hello from fish $FISH_VERSION"
```

## For Loops

```{term}
for i in (seq 5)
  echo "Item $i"
end
```

## String Manipulation

```{term}
set greeting "Hello, World!"
echo (string upper $greeting)
echo (string replace "World" "Fish" $greeting)
```

## Lists

```{term}
set fruits apple banana cherry
for fruit in $fruits
  echo "I like $fruit"
end
echo "Count: "(count $fruits)
```
